messages:
Tess (CS): Quick flag — SolaceTech trial shows intermittent p95 spikes ~2s during business hours. They’re concerned about cost too. Proposing combo: compact-v1-int8 for short queries, base-v2-fp16 for long, and enable prefix KV for chat sessions. Thoughts? cc @lena @arjun

Arjun (Solutions): Agree in principle. Need traffic split numbers and a small quality check on their summarization endpoint before rolling.

Lena (Eng-runtime): Pulled 48h sample: 70% <=70 prompt_tokens. I ran a micro A/B (1.5k requests):
```
baseline base-v2-fp16: p95=2000ms, avg=300ms, quality_err=0.6%
compact-v1-int8: p95=640ms, avg=170ms, quality_err=0.9%
split routing est p95~=720ms, est cost delta -39%
```
Propose route: if prompt_tokens <=70 -> compact-v1-int8 else base-v2-fp16. Canary 20% for 48h. Will enable KV cache for chat flows.

Tess (CS): Can you paste Console route JSON and a one-paragraph blurb I can send to the customer about risks/benefits? Need to prepare for their TAM call.

Lena (Eng-runtime): Route JSON for Console:
{"name":"solacetech-split-int8","rules":[{"if":"prompt_tokens <= 70","route":"compact-v1-int8"},{"else":"base-v2-fp16"}],"canary":{"duration":"48h","percent":20}}

DevBot: canary created solacetech-int8-canary-8061234599

Arjun (Solutions): Quality delta 0.3% absolute — within our soft threshold. Recommend focused eval on summarization and the two top customer prompts. If regressions appear, add an endpoint override for summarize -> base-v2-fp16.

Tess (CS): I'll schedule a 20m prep with their PM for 2026-11-02 10:00 ET. I'll send the blurb and the canary link.

Lena (Eng-runtime): Action: run full 10k A/B (eta 6h) and drop results here + perf graphs. Also turn on prefix KV cache; that usually trims p50 by ~12% on session flows.

Arjun (Solutions): I'll prepare a 1-page showing estimated p95 improvement, cost savings, and the fallback plan. Also include rollback conditions (quality_delta > 0.7% or error_rate increase).

Tess (CS): Thanks — this feels like a tangible renewal play. I'll collect 20 sample customer prompts to add to eval set.
